notes: These mappings use the exact ownership-service section labels and declarations in the pinned IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API headers. The test is limited to one ordinary object attribute and one pending acquirer; it excludes multi-recipient arbitration, DDM, timestamped delivery, and provider-specific behavior. This is candidate API traceability, not a conformance claim.

requirements.statement: The prospective owner requests the adapter-supplied object attribute through ordinary Attribute Ownership Acquisition and supplies a user tag that is checked on the owner's release-request callback.
The owner invokes Divestiture If Wanted for the pending acquisition and the RTI-returned divested-attribute set exactly matches the attribute transferred by this one-attribute case.
The owner receives the pending acquisition's object, candidate attribute set, and acquisition request tag before divesting the requested attribute.
The pending acquirer receives the transferred object and attribute set with the Divestiture If Wanted user tag, and the test verifies ownership has moved from the former owner.
